X8.quote: The plots in this section show the mean value of 20 test-time training curves as a solid line, while the shaded area represents the interquartile range.

doubts: The spread is over 20 independent test-time trainings (each on a freshly sampled randomized environment) of a single meta-learned loss; the outer-loop meta-training itself is not repeated, so the band mixes training seeds and task variation.
